Electricity Bill Calculator with Default Arguments
Problem Statement

Design a C++ program to calculate the electricity bill of a customer using class, data members, member functions, and default arguments.

The program must:

Use a class ElectricityBill

Keep data members private

Use a member function with a default argument

Take user input

Display the final bill amount

Requirements
Private Data Members:

string customerName

int unitsConsumed

double ratePerUnit

double totalBill

Public Member Functions:

void setDetails(string name, int units)

Store customer name and units consumed.

void calculateBill(double rate = 5.0)

This function must use a default argument

If rate is not provided, use default ₹5 per unit

Formula:

totalBill = unitsConsumed × rate

void display()

Display:

Customer Name: <name>
Units Consumed: <units>
Rate per Unit: <rate>
Total Bill: <totalBill upto 2 decimal places>

Input Format

Single line input:

customerName units rate

Rule:

If rate entered is 0, use default rate (5.0)

Otherwise use the entered rate

Output Format

Print details exactly as specified.
